name: BACH_0039
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (69%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes InSitu (26%), so in situ carcinoma cannot be excluded [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 69%, InSitu 26%, Benign 5%, Invasive 1% (test ECE 5%) | Low invasive risk, InSitu possible |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Normal from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 86% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] (error AUROC 70%) | Typical input, moderate error ranking |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (85%–88% similarity) [F5]; InSitu contrast 81% | Neighbors Normal, close InSitu contrast |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable 0/20 detector drives largest score against invasion (-1.55) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.45) pushing away from invasion [F3] (20/20 check) · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.42) against invasion [F4], caption inconsistent (18/20 check) · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical duct confinement (-0.66) slightly raises risk (+0.39); 12/20 check · Weak
- **Dead cell fraction** (regions 3, 9, 10) · context · 5% (97th percentile) [F7]; only 4 neoplastic nuclei, wrong-direction feature · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (mean +0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- An in situ lesion is present; InSitu is 26% and matches contrast case BACH_0124 at 81% similarity.
- Focal atypia lies in deeper levels or regions masked by the unreliable normal-lobules score.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Inspect highest-risk tiles for stromal infiltration, nuclear pleomorphism, and dead cells.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 9**: Verify two-layered lobular epithelium directly; do not trust the unreliable normal-lobules score.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: Check ducts for atypia; consider drafted deeper levels and CK5/6, ER stains.
